description: NISAR radar satellites can detect ground changes through clouds, day or night, but the data is too complex for most people to use. We're building a simple web tool that compares radar scenes over time and turns them into clear map alerts: where land is sinking, where flooding has spread, where the surface is changing. We're starting with Egypt's Nile Delta. Planners, farmers and insurers get plain-language warnings instead of raw files, so they can act early.
